title: 第十九章 蝼蚁宝鱼第二十章 撒网定乾坤
slug: 从白猿拳破限开始成就人间武圣
content_zh:
三人听后，顿时脑瓜子一嗡，没想到就这么被淘汰了。
其中一女子，身子一软，瘫坐在地，捂着脸呜呜痛哭起来。
母亲为了让自己学武，委身于村里流氓，才换来了这次机会，可是自己就这么失败了，以后的人生彻底完了……
她的哭声压抑而绝望，像是钝刀子割在众人心头。
马飞脸色惨白，双眼瞬间充血：“我前日突破一次扣关失败了，但是还有机会突破，再让我留几日，我定能突破！”
围观的学徒们鸦雀无声，几位内院的师兄们则是习以为常。
每月这时候，学武这条路的残酷都会血淋淋的展现在眼前。
这马飞一次突破失败，根骨又是中下，再次突破的机会几乎渺茫。
林婉竹摇摇头，毫不犹豫的把马飞的名字划掉。
“规矩就是规矩，走吧！”
“规矩？去他妈的规矩！”
马飞彻底疯了。积压了三个月的怨气、嫉妒、不甘，在这一刻如火山爆发。
他指着内院的方向，唾沫横飞：
“你们这群吸血鬼！拿着我们的血汗钱，把我们当猪狗养！你们每周只给外院学徒一次汤药，内院却是天天有！如此这般，怎能突破？
还有凭什么有人就能进内院，我们就不能？
就因为我们没钱！没关系！
老子要把这破武馆的黑幕抖出去！让全城人都知道你们这群骗子的嘴脸！”
马飞不甘的吼叫着。
“聒噪！”秦雨早已不耐烦，面色一冷，脚下一动，瞬间出现在马飞身前
她柳眉倒竖，眼中满是厌恶：“蝼蚁一样的东西，也配谈公平？”

她甚至没有摆架势，随意一拳轰出。
砰！
一声闷响，马飞骂声戛然而止，整个人像个破麻袋一样倒飞出去，狠狠撞在三丈外的练功桩上。
咔嚓！
胸骨碎裂的声音随即响起。
马飞像一滩烂泥般滑落，痛苦的咳嗽声剧烈响起，一脸喷出数口鲜血。
诸多学徒们噤若寒蝉。虽然此刻多有兔死狐悲之意，但是没人敢开口。
这一拳，没有丝毫留手！
在她眼里，或许随手杀了马飞，也不过像是碾死蝼蚁一般。
此刻死亡的恐惧终于压下了一切，马飞连忙跪下求饶，“饶命……师姐饶命……我错了，我再也不敢了……。”
秦雨冷哼一声，蝼蚁一样的东西，竟敢污蔑武馆，当真找死。
又是一脚踹在马飞胸口，将其踹飞出去。
“噗！”
马飞再次砸落在地，猛然喷出一口鲜血，染红了地上的青石砖，挡在胸前的一只胳膊也再次骨裂断掉。
“饶命，饶命！”马飞一只胳膊撑着爬起，犹如一条死狗一般，不断跪着磕头，只为求活。
眼看秦雨还要动手，身后秦师淡淡开口：“惩戒一番就罢了，莫要耽误考核时间。”
马飞连忙叩头，砰砰磕的青砖血迹模糊，高喊一句，“谢秦师姐饶命！”
……
content_en:
After the three people heard this, their minds suddenly buzzed. They didn't expect to be eliminated like this.
One of the women's body went limp, and she collapsed on the ground, covering her face and sobbing bitterly.
In order for her to learn martial arts, her mother committed herself to a gangster in the village in exchange for this opportunity. However, she failed just like that, and her future life was completely ruined...
Her cries were suppressed and desperate, like a dull knife cutting into everyone's hearts.
Ma Fei's face turned pale, and his eyes were instantly bloodshot: "I failed to break through a button the day before yesterday, but there is still a chance to break through. If I stay for a few more days, I will definitely be able to break through!"
The apprentices who were watching were silent, but the senior brothers in the inner courtyard were used to it.
At this time of every month, the cruelty of learning martial arts will be bloody before your eyes.
This Ma Fei failed to break through once, and his strength is average. The chance of breaking through again is almost slim.
Lin Wanzhu shook her head and crossed out Ma Fei's name without hesitation.
"Rules are rules, let's go!"
"Rules? Fuck the rules!"
Ma Fei went completely crazy. The resentment, jealousy, and unwillingness that had accumulated for three months erupted like a volcano at this moment.
He pointed in the direction of the inner courtyard, spitting:
"You bunch of vampires! You take our hard-earned money and treat us like pigs and dogs! You only give soup to the apprentices in the outer courtyard once a week, but you give them to the inner courtyard every day! How can we break through like this?
Why can some people enter the inner courtyard, but we can't?
Just because we have no money! It doesn't matter!
I want to get rid of the shady story of this broken martial arts hall! Let the whole city know the faces of you liars! "
Ma Fei roared unwillingly.
"Noisy!" Qin Yu was already impatient, his face turned cold, his feet moved, and he appeared in front of Ma Fei in an instant
Her eyebrows were raised, her eyes full of disgust: "How can something like an ant be worthy of talking about fairness?"
She didn't even put up a posture and just punched out casually.
Bang!
With a muffled sound, Ma Fei's curses suddenly stopped, and his whole body flew out like a broken sack, hitting the practice pile three feet away.
Click!
The sound of sternum breaking was heard immediately.
Ma Fei slid down like a puddle of mud, coughing violently in pain, and several mouthfuls of blood spurted out from his face.
Many apprentices remained silent. Although many people felt sad about the death of a rabbit or a fox at this moment, no one dared to speak.
This punch didn't hold anything back!
In her eyes, maybe killing Ma Fei casually would be like crushing an ant.
At this moment, the fear of death finally suppressed everything. Ma Fei quickly knelt down and begged for mercy, "Spare my life...Sister, please spare my life...I was wrong, I never dare to do it again..."
Qin Yu snorted coldly, "Things like ants dare to slander the martial arts hall and are really looking for death."
He kicked Ma Fei in the chest again and kicked him out.
"Poof!"
Ma Fei hit the ground again and suddenly spurted out a mouthful of blood, staining the bluestone tiles on the ground red. The arm blocking his chest was broken again.
"Spare your life, spare your life!" Ma Fei climbed up with one arm, like a dead dog, constantly kneeling and kowtowing, just to survive.
Seeing that Qin Yu was about to take action, Master Qin behind him said calmly: "Just punish him. Don't delay the assessment time."
Ma Fei kowtowed quickly, the bricks he banged were stained with blood, and shouted, "Thank you, Senior Sister Qin, for sparing your life!"
